articles.summary: New features enable premium subscribers to access unprecedented daypart-level station ranking detail, reported in near real-time as DTS AutoStage surpasses 16 million vehicles globally Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) today announced the launch of DTS AutoStage Broadcaster Portal Premium , a new standard in radio intelligence that advances the company’s existing broadcaster portal to provide radio stations with the most comprehensive and timely listening analytics available on the market.
